merge_json_values: merge two JSON objects recursively where common dict keys are merged and other values are replaced
merge_at_path: merge a new JSON value into an existing object at a dotted path like a.b.c
merge_from_cli_arg: parse a CLI assignment string like a.b.c=some_value and merge it into a JSON object
convert_python_to_json: convert any Python object including dataclasses, numpy arrays, and enums to a JSON-serializable value
validate_json_against_type: validate and convert a JSON object to a typed Python object using type annotations like List or Dict
